meta.title: Ghost serializer codegen
meta.subtitle: Attributes and templates become compiled function pointers in a descriptor table

views.label: What the generator reads
views.note: Your attributes are the schema. The templates are the code shapes, one per field type.

views.label: What it emits
views.note: A serializer struct per component, and one registration system per assembly.

views.label: How the runtime dispatches
views.note: Index into a buffer, then an indirect call. No reflection after startup.

cards.title: Why there is no reflection
items: The generator runs during C# compilation, not during baking
By the time a world exists, serialization is already machine code
Dispatch is an index into a buffer plus an indirect call
An assembly that does not reference NetCode is skipped, silently

cards.title: Quantization is a compression trick
items: Copy to snapshot rounds value times scale into an integer
The change mask then compares integers, not floats
Values that jitter in the last decimal place compare equal and cost nothing
Too coarse and prediction can never agree, so you roll back every tick

cards.title: The delta is against a prediction
items: Three baselines are kept, and a predictor extrapolates from the trend
It falls back to the newest baseline when the extrapolation is worse
The residual is entropy coded, so near-zero costs a handful of bits
Constant velocity is therefore almost free on the wire

cards.title: Read it yourself
items: Create the source generator analyzer config from the Assets menu
Turn on write files to disk, then open the generated folder
Serialize is one guarded packed write per field, in plain C sharp
That is the entire wire format for that component
